questions.question: A pole 23 m long reaches a window which is 3sqrt5 m above the ground on one side of a street. Keeping its foot at the same point, the pole is turned to the other side of the street to reach a window 4sqrt15 m high. What is the width (in m) of the street?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of the pole = 23 m

The first window is 3√5 m above the ground and the second window is 4√15 m above the ground.

**Formula used:**

In a right-angled triangle,

Base = √(Hypotenuse² - Perpendicular²)

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/653b57e007cd822dc84f2c0bb4aab03f4f06c436f134f5ebee857b4f0c8b170b.png] **

Here, the width of the street = BC

In ΔABO,

BO = √(AO² - AB²)

= √(232 - 3√52)

= √(529 - 45)

= √484

= 22 m

In ΔOCD,

CO = √(DO2 - DC2)

= √(232 - 4√152)

= √(529 - 240)

= √289 = 17 m

Then, BC = BO + CO 

= 22 + 17 

= 39 m

**∴ The width (in m) of the street is 39 m**

questions.question: A vertical pole and a vertical tower are on the same level of ground in such a way that from the top of the pole, the angle of elevation of the top of the tower is 60º and the angle of depression of the bottom of the tower is 30º. If the height of the tower is 76 m, then find the height (in m) of the pole.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The angle of elevation of the top of the tower from the top of the pole = 60º

The angle of depression of the bottom of the tower from the top of the pole = 30º

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfb0c2544a2bad663ee4e25a4d647add56b66beaf0b065aece991286147b366f.png] **

Let, the height of the pole (AB) = CD = x m

So, the height of ED = (76 - x) m

So, In ΔACD, tan 30° = CD/AD

⇒ 1/√3 = x/AD

⇒ AD = √3x .....(1)

In ΔAED, tan 60° = ED/AD

⇒ √3 = (76 - x)/√3x

⇒ 76 - x = 3x

⇒ 3x + x = 76

⇒ 4x = 76

⇒ x = 76/4 = 19

**∴ The height (in m) of the pole is 19 m**

questions.question: The width of the path around a square field is 4.5 m and its area is 105.75 m². Find the cost of fencing the field at the rate of Rs. 100 per meter.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The width of the path around a square field = 4.5 m

The area of the path = 105.75 m2

**Formula used:**

The perimeter of a square = 4 × Side

The area of a square = (Side)²

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/273325535b4eab9aacdb05e77bda70db8cbdad19bcb9dfe1f6589f46cb528595.png] **

Let, each side of the field = x

Then, each side with the path = x + 4.5 + 4.5 = x + 9

So, (x + 9)² - x² = 105.75

⇒ x2 + 18x + 81 - x2 = 105.75

⇒ 18x + 81 = 105.75

⇒ 18x = 105.75 - 81 = 24.75

⇒ x = 24.75/18 = 11/8

∴ Each side of the square field = 11/8 m

The perimterer = 4 × (11/8) = 11/2 m

So, the total cost of fencing = (11/2) × 100 = Rs. 550

**∴ The cost of fencing of the field is Rs. 550**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**In such types of questions, 

Area of path outside the Square is, 

⇒ (2a + 2w)2w = 105.75

here, a is a side of a square and w is width of a square

⇒ (2a + 9)9 = 105.75

⇒ 2a + 9 = 11.75

⇒ 2a = 2.75

Perimeter of a square = 4a

⇒ 2 × 2a = 2 × 2.75 = 5.50

costing of fencing = 5.50 × 100 = 550

∴ The cost of fencing of the field is Rs. 550

questions.question: An alloy contains 40% of silver, 30% of copper, and 30% of nickel. How much silver (in kg) should be added to 25 kg of the alloy so that the new alloy contains 50% of silver?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Silver = 40%; Copper = 30%; Nickel = 30%

Let, the total weight of alloy = 100 units

So, the silver = 40 units

If we add 20 units silver then, alloy = (100 + 20) = 120 units

also, silver = 40 + 20 = 60 units

Now, silver is 50% of the alloy [∵ silver = 60 and alloy = 120]

So, 100 units = 25 kg

⇒ 20 units = (25/100) × 20 = 5 kg

∴ A total of 5 kg silver (in kg) should be added to 25 kg of the alloy so that the new alloy contains 50% of silver.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

An alloy contains 40% of silver, 30% of copper, and 30% of nickel.

Total weight of the alloy = 25 kg

The required percentage of silver = 50%

**Calculation:**

The ratio of silver, copper and nickel = 40 : 30 : 30 = 4 : 3 : 3

Let, total silver = 4x; copper = 3x; and nickel = 3x

So, 4x + 3x + 3x = 25

⇒ 10x = 25

⇒ 4x = (25/10) × 4 = 10

The weight of silver in 25 kg = 10 kg

Suppose, the amount of silver added = a kg

Then, (10 + a) = 1/2 (25 + a) [∵ 50% = 1/2]

⇒ 20 + 2a = 25 + a

⇒ 2a - a = 25 - 20

⇒ a = 5

**∴ A total of 5 kg silver (in kg) should be added to 25 kg of the alloy so that the new alloy contains 50% of silver.**

questions.question:
Simplify the following expression:

{{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The given expression = {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

**Formula used:**

If a + b + c = 0 then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

**Calculation:**

{{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

= {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + {{(4b² - 16c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

Let, a² - 4b² = x; 4b² - 16c² = y; 16c² - a² = z

Here, x + y + z = a2 - 4b2 + 4b2 - 16c2 + 16c2 - a2 = 0

Then, (a2 - 4b2)³ + (4b2 - 16c2)³ + (16c2 - a2)³ = 3 (a2 - 4b2) (4b2 - 16c2) (16c2 - a2)

Let, a - 2b = p; 2b - 4c = q; 4c - a = r

Here, p + q + r = a - 2b + 2b - 4c + 4c - a = 0

Then, (a - 2b)³ + (2b - 4c)³ + (4c - a)³ = 3 (a - 2b) (2b - 4c) (4c - a)

Now, {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + {{(4b² - 16c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}} = (3(a²-4b²)(4b²-16c²)(16c²-a²))/(3(a-2b)(2b-4c)(4c-a))

= ((a+2b)(a-2b)(2b+4c)(2b-4c)(4c+a)(4c-a))/((a-2b)(2b-4c)(4c-a)) [Using a² - b² = (a + b) (a - b) formula]

= (a + 2b) (2b + 4c) (4c + a)

= 2 (a + 2b) (b + 2c) (4c + a)

**∴ The value of the expression is 2 (a+ 2b) (b + 2c) (4c + a)**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** {{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}} 

We know that a + b + c = 0 then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

First, we satisfy the numerator and denominator with this equation.

⇒ (a² - 4b²) + (4b² - 16c²) + (16c² - a²) = 0 

Now, (a - 2b) + (2b - 4c) + (4c - a) = 0

{{{(a²-4b²)}³} + 64 {{(b² - 4c²)}³} + {{(16c² -a²})³}} over {{(a-2b)³} +{(2b-4c)³} +{(4c-a)³}}

⇒ {3{(a²-4b²)}{(4b² - 16c²)}{(16c² -a²})} over {3{(a-2b)}{(2b-4c)}{(4c-a)}} = {(a-2b)(a+2b)(2b-4c)(2b+4c)(4c-a)(4c+a)}over{(a-2b)(2b-4c)(4c-a)} 

⇒ (a + 2b){2(b + 2c)}(4c + a)

⇒ 2(a + 2b)(b + 2c)(4c + a)

**∴ The value of the expression is 2(a + 2b)(b + 2c)(4c + a).**

questions.question: Find the greatest number which divides 108, 124 and 156, leaving the same remainder.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The given numbers are 108, 124 and 156

After dividing by the greatest number x, the remainder in each case is the same.

Concept used:

The greatest number that will divide a, b, and c and leaving the same remainder in each case is given by the HCF of |a - b|, |b - c|, and |c - a|

**Calculation:**

Here, |108 - 124| = |- 16| = 16

|124 - 156| = |- 32| = 32

|156 - 108| = 48

Prime factors of 16 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2

Prime factors of 32 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2

Prime factors of 48 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3

So, HCF of 16, 32, and 48 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 16

**∴ The greatest number is 16**

questions.question: X, Y and Z can do a piece of work in 46 days, 92 days and 23 days, respectively, X started the work. Y joined him after 2 days. If Z joined them after 8 days from the beginning then for how many days did X work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24b89b3ead9324cd75eef9d82076d5f420a4ab97989e5e9d0b316974561d7baf.png] __**

Total work = 92 units (LCM of 46, 92, and 23)

Efficiency = Work/Time

Total efficiency = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7 units

X complete in 2 days = 2 × 2 = 4 work

X and Y complete in 6 days = 6 × (2 + 1) = 18 work

The remaining work = 92 - (4 + 18) = 92 - 22 = 70 work

Time is taken by X, Y, and Z to complete remaining work = 70/7 = 10 days

Total work done by X = 8 + 10 = 18 days

∴ X work the total of 18 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

X, Y, and Z can do a piece of work in 46 days, 92 days, and 23 days respectively.

**Calculation:**

X can finish in 1 day = 1/46 work

Y can finish in 1 day = 1/92 work

Z can finish in 1 day = 1/23 work

X and Y can finish in 1 day = (1/46) + (1/92) = 3/92 work

X, Y, and Z can finish together in 1 day = (1/46) + (1/92) + (1/23) = 7/92 work

X can do in 2 days = 2/46 = 1/23 work

X and Y can do in 6 days = 6 × (3/92) = 9/46 work [∵ Z joined them after 8 days from the beginning]

The remaining work = 1 - [(1/23) + (9/46)] = 1 - (11/46) = 35/46 work

Time is taken by X, Y, and Z to finish the work = (35/46) ÷ (7/92) = (35/46) × (92/7) = 10 days

Total time of work of X = 8 + 10 = 18 days

**∴ X work the total of 18 days**

questions.question: A sum invested at compound interest amounts to Rs. 7,800 in 3 years and Rs. 11,232 in 5 years. What is the rate per cent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Sum becomes Rs. 7800 in 3 years and Rs. 11232 in 5 years

Formula used:

At compound interest, the final amount = P(1+(r)/(100) )ⁿ

Where, P = The sum of the amount

r = Rate of interest

n = Time (years)

Calculation:

Here, Rs. 7800 becomes Rs. 11232 at compound interest in two years.

Let, the rate of interest = R

So, 11232 = 7800(1+(R)/(100) )²

⇒ [(100 + R)/100]² = 11232/7800

⇒ [(100 + R)/100]2 = 144/100

⇒ [(100 + R)/100]2 = (12/10)²

⇒ [(100 + R)/100] = (12/10)

⇒ 100 + R = 1200/10 = 120

⇒ R = 120 - 100 = 20

**∴ The rate per cent is 20%**

questions.question: A car runs first 275 km at an average speed of 50 km/h and the next 315 km at an average speed of 70 km/h. What is the average speed ( in km/h) for the entire journey?
questions.solution:

Average speed = Total Distance/Total time

**Calculation:**

Time is taken to covers 275 km = 275/50 = 11/2 hours

Time is taken to covers 315 km = 315/70 = 9/2 hours

The average speed = (275 + 315)/(11/2 + 9/2) km/h

= 590/10 km/h

= 59 km/h

**∴ The average speed (in km/h) for the entire journey is 59 km/h**

questions.question: How many numbers are there from 500 to 650 (including both) which are divisible neither by 3 nor by 7?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers are from 500 to 650 which are divisible neither by 3 nor by 7

**Calculation:**

The total numbers up to 500 are divisible by 3 = 500/3 → 166 (Quotient)

The total numbers up to 500 are divisible by 7 = 500/7 → 71 (Quotient)

The total numbers up to 500 are divisible by 21 = 500/21 → 23 (Quotient)

The total numbers up to 650 are divisible by 3 = 650/3 → 216 (Quotient)

The total numbers up to 650 are divisible by 7 = 650/7 → 92 (Quotient)

The total numbers up to 650 are divisible by 21 = 650/21 → 30 (Quotient)

⇒ The total number divisible by 3 between 500 and 650 = 216 - 166 = 50

⇒ The total number divisible by 7 between 500 and 650 = 92 - 71 = 21

⇒ The total number divisible by 21 between 500 and 650 = 30 - 23 = 7

The total numbers from 500 to 650 = 150 + 1 = 151

∴ The required numbers = 151 - (50 + 21 - 7) = 151 - 64 = 87

**∴ The are total 87 numbers from 500 to 650 (including both) which are neither divisible by 3 nor by 7**

**Given:**

(4x + 2y)³ + (4x - 2y)³ = 16 (Ax³ + Bxy²) .....(1)

**Formula used:**

a³ + b³ = (a + b) (a² + b² - ab)

(a + b)2 + (a - b)2 = 2 (a2 + b2)

a2 - b2 = (a + b) (a - b)

**Calculation:**

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = (4x + 2y + 4x - 2y) [(4x + 2y)2 + (4x - 2y)2 - (4x + 2y) (4x - 2y)]

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 8x [2 (16x² + 4y²)] - (16x² - 4y²)

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 8x (32x² + 8y² - 16x2 + 4y2)

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 8x (16x2 + 12y2)

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 16 (8x3 + 6xy2) .....(2)

Justifying equations (1) and (2),

A = 8 and B = 6

So, (1/2) √(A² + B²) = (1/2) √(82 + 62)

= 1/2 × √(64 + 36)

= 1/2 × √100

= 1/2 × 10 = 5

**∴ The value of (1/2) √(A2 + B2) is 5**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 16 (Ax3 + Bxy2) –––––––– (1)

(a +b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) 

(4x + 2y)³ = 64x³ + 8y³ + 24xy(4x + 2y)

⇒ 64x3 + 8y3 + 96x²y + 48xy² –––––––– (2)

And, (4x – 2y)3 = 64x3 – 8y3 – 24xy(4x – 2y)

⇒ 64x3 – 8y3 – 96x2y + 48xy² –––––––– (3)

Adding the equation 1 and 2, we have

 (4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)³ = 128x³ + 96xy² = 16(8x³ + 6xy²) –– (4)

Justifying equations (1) and (4), we have

A = 8, and B = 6

{1over 2 }{(√{A² +B²})} = 1over2 sqrt{A²+B²} = 1over2 sqrt{8²+6²} 

⇒ 1over2 × 10 = 5

∴ **The value of 1over2sqrt{A²+B²} is 5**
